items.name: FLANGER_DEPTH_RANGE
items.doc: The flanger's peak-to-peak excursion above its declared 0.5 ms base.

items.name: FLANGER_FEEDBACK_RANGE
items.doc: The flanger's SIGNED resonance. The ±0.95 clamp is DECLARED here — a PATCH asking for 1.0 is answered by this travel — and the kernel's own clamp is the enforcement half.

items.name: FLANGER_MIX_RANGE
items.doc: The flanger's wet/dry, as an instance of DRIVE_MIX_RANGE: 50 %, equal dry and wet, where the comb is deepest.

items.name: FLANGER_BASE_MS
items.doc: The flanger's base delay, ms: the sweep rides on it up to the depth.

items.name: FLANGER_MAX_MS

source.origin: omx-dsp 6d6fcda include/omxdsp/fx/omx_flanger.h OMX_FLANGER_MAX_MS (the sum typed as a literal)

items.doc: The longest delay a flanger sweep reaches, rounded up to whole ms: the base delay plus the depth maximum. The delay line is sized from it.
